name: Lunar Chrono
summary:
Lunar Chrono puts you in command of a spaceship in frantic time trials, overcoming multiple challenges. Prove your skill as a galactic pilot and become the fastest in the galaxy!

UPDATED! 1.2.1

THIS VERSION INCLUDES:
- Demo mode with one map
- 4 races, 2 challenge modes (Time Trial and Portals)

THE FULL VERSION WILL INCLUDE:
- 3 complete maps. New ones will be added in future updates.

- Time Trial mode: Get comfortable in your cockpit and beat the races within the time limit.

- Portals mode: Demonstrat
